values.description: Issuer of the local stack (deploy/compose.yaml). Used as the base URL of every request, as the aud of every client assertion and as the base of every DPoP htu. Must equal the issuer in discovery.
Seeded user of the mock identity system (esignet/docker-compose/init.sql).
OTP the mock identity system accepts for every request.
Sent with the identifier step. The local stack has no captcha validator, so any non-empty value passes.
Bearer JWT for /client-mgmt/*; leave empty when scope enforcement is off (the local stack).
